g.title: ESP32
g.text: Goouuu ESP32S 38P. Yellow pin is signal, red pin is 5V, black pin is GND.

g.title: I2S
g.text: Signal wires are the yellow header pins.

g.title: MAX98357A
g.text: GAIN and SD stay open. Do not tie them to GND or 3.3V.

g.title: Speaker
g.text: Both wires go only to the amplifier speaker terminals.
